summary_markdown: The discussion addressed the safety of running recalculations (recalc) in ClickHouse. It was confirmed that if aggregates were run only once, it is fine. However, a concern was raised regarding how aggregate cleanup is integrated into the recalculation process. If the aggregates are run a second time without an intervening recalculation, there is a risk of duplication.
decisions: It is safe to proceed with the current setup.
